disclaimer: Provider terms may change. API/search availability and free access to image bytes are different. This registry is descriptive and not a credential or a guaranteed access entitlement.

sources.name: Alaska Satellite Facility
sources.notes: Radar imagery metadata; Earthdata login required for many downloads. ASF Search API adapter in all three SDKs. Anonymous NISAR and ALOS-2 metadata verified 2026-10-16; explorer opt-in includes these alongside Sentinel-1. NISAR PROVISIONAL products are not fully validated.

sources.name: Capella Open Data
sources.notes: Selected SAR scenes, CC BY 4.0 programme. Static STAC metadata and PNG thumbnail HEAD returned anonymous HTTP 200 with wildcard CORS on 2026-10-16. Requires a bounded, deduplicating static adapter; no Item Search endpoint verified. Native collection metadata says proprietary, so retain the explicit programme licence reference.

sources.name: Copernicus Data Space
sources.notes: Public discovery; downloads and other APIs may require registration and authentication. STAC adapter implemented in all three SDKs.

sources.name: Element 84 Earth Search
sources.notes: Public STAC catalogue; image asset links can have different cloud storage cost and access conditions.

sources.name: ESA Sentinel-1/-2 Acquisition Plans
sources.notes: Plans are published as KML for S1C/S1D and S2A/S2B/S2C. Future datatakes are planned, not acquired images; Sentinel-2 nominal swaths only. Direct ESA requests from web browsers may require a same-origin proxy.

sources.name: EUMETSAT Data Store
sources.notes: Check registration, collection access, and licensing before download.

sources.name: INPE CBERS-4A (Brazil)
sources.notes: Brazil-focused 2 m fused visual collection under CC BY 4.0. Spatial/date POST search and CORS preflight verified 2026-10-16. Live items advertise tci GeoTIFF and thumbnail PNG (HEAD 200; no preview CORS header). Item platform/gsd may be absent; midnight timestamps do not establish acquisition-hour precision.

sources.name: JAXA G-Portal
sources.notes: G-Portal granule adapter in all three SDKs (anonymous CSW 3.0.0 GET returning GeoJSON; numeric datasetId required, GET-only). Recorded-shape contract tests; the bbox axis order and live smoke are operator-triggered verifications.

sources.name: Maxar Open Data (public releases)
sources.notes: Selected commercial-satellite event releases, not the entire paid archive. CC BY-NC 4.0. Bounded static STAC traversal; extents prune location/date, ARD tiles retain native identity and metadata. Native tile cloud percentages are not scene-wide cloud cover.

sources.name: NASA Common Metadata Repository
sources.notes: Earthdata authentication required for some downloads. Mission coverage varies. STAC adapter implemented in all three SDKs.

sources.name: NASA GIBS
sources.notes: Rendered time-enabled map tiles; not a generic individual-scene archive.

sources.name: NOAA GOES Open Data
sources.notes: Cloud object listings rather than a uniform STAC scene search.

sources.name: OpenAerialMap
sources.notes: Crowdsourced aerial imagery (drone/aircraft). Anonymous metadata search via api.openaerialmap.org/meta with a bbox and an acquisition window; records carry a tilejson asset but no preview thumbnail, and per-image licences vary. Adapter implemented in all three SDKs.

sources.name: Planet
sources.notes: Catalogue visibility and assets can depend on plan entitlements.

sources.name: Microsoft Planetary Computer
sources.notes: Catalog search is public; actual assets often require a signed URL and access rules apply.

sources.name: SkyFi
sources.notes: Free account API key for catalogue; commercial image purchase separate.

sources.name: Umbra Open Data
sources.notes: Selected SAR scenes and recurring sites under CC BY 4.0; not arbitrary-location tasking. Static STAC root and a dated scene verified anonymously with wildcard CORS on 2026-10-16; sampled scene has no PNG/JPEG preview asset. Requires bounded static catalogue traversal or a metadata index; no Item Search endpoint verified.

sources.name: UP42
sources.notes: Account/organization eligibility applies; never assume anonymous free queries.

sources.name: USGS LandsatLook
sources.notes: Historical Landsat imagery. Future collection calendar is a separate service, not a published STAC item. STAC adapter implemented in all three SDKs.

sources.name: Vantor (formerly Maxar Intelligence)
sources.notes: Authorized hub credentials required. Public free search not assumed.

sources.name: Wyvern Open Data
sources.notes: Selected Dragonette hyperspectral scenes under CC BY 4.0; not the full archive. Static STAC scene and preview HEAD returned anonymous HTTP 200 with wildcard CORS on 2026-10-16. Requires bounded static traversal using one hierarchy and native scene IDs to avoid duplicate catalogues; no Item Search endpoint verified.
